payload.title: analyzeDocStaleness does not de-duplicate the files of overlapping roots, so a document reached by two roots is scanned twice and emits two findings and two observations with identical ids
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/doc-staleness-adapter.ts:377-384 (the root list is flat-mapped through docsUnder and filtered by the snapshot; no de-duplication)
tools/aria-adapters/doc-staleness-adapter.ts:396-399 (each entry of docs is read and scanned again)
tools/aria-adapters/doc-staleness-adapter.ts:409-421 (one finding per stale reference per entry, id doc-staleness:missing:<doc>:<line>:<ref>)
tools/aria-adapters/doc-staleness-adapter.ts:431-441 (read_paths is de-duplicated with a Set but findings and docCount are not)
payload.rule_violated: An adapter output must hold one finding per id; read_paths already de-duplicates, so the output contradicts itself.
payload.notes: With roots ['docs', 'docs/a.md'], ['README.md', 'README.md'] or ['apps', 'apps/svc/README.md'] the adapter returns two findings with the same id for one stale reference, one read path and cost_units 1, found by running analyzeDocStaleness on a scratch tree. The manifest has no overlap today (13 disjoint roots), so only a manifest edit or a direct caller triggers it; the file-root form adds a new spelling of an overlap that already existed for directory roots. Close condition: De-duplicate the collected document list (a Set before the snapshot filter) and add a scenario with overlapping roots asserting one finding per reference and docCount equal to the distinct documents. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 1). Verified at head a47dc4d57c of open pull request #2134; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
